_comment: Hand decisions read by tool/build_observation_concept_map.py. Everything not listed here is derived:
CDC's own SNOMED/CVX/PHIN VS rows from the Coded Observations sheet, ICD-10-CM rows from NLM's SNOMED CT
to ICD-10-CM map (tool/derive_icd10_observation_rows.py), and Grey's yes/no in CROSSWALK-REVIEW.tsv.
Equivalence is ConceptMap R4 equivalence, read target to source: 'equivalent' or 'wider' asserts the
observation; 'narrower' and 'relatedto' record the link without asserting it (clinical judgement).

not_from_a_code._comment: Observations no single chart code can establish. Every row reaching them is graded 'relatedto'.
not_from_a_code.002: Undergoing ELECTIVE splenectomy: a planned procedure; a recorded splenectomy is already asplenia.
not_from_a_code.026: Perinatal HIV, not severely immunosuppressed, AND MMR before antiretroviral therapy: needs timing and CD4.
not_from_a_code.033: Influenza antiviral within the previous 48 hours: needs the administration date, not the drug code.
not_from_a_code.034: LONG-TERM aspirin therapy: an aspirin order or the CDC finding code does not say long-term.
not_from_a_code.038: Sex partner of an HBsAg-positive person: CDC codes are pieces (sexual partners + contact with + HBsAg positive).

_comment: CDC SNOMED codes broader than the observation they are filed under. An ICD-10-CM code reached only through one
of them is not asserted automatically: it goes on CROSSWALK-REVIEW.tsv and is decided there (Grey, 2026-10-21:
Claude reviews them AND OpenEvidence reviews them). Found by tool/broad_code_census.py, 2026-10-21, which
counted for every CDC code the ICD-10-CM rows reached through it alone; each code with any such row was compared
with its observation title. Codes whose meaning is the observation itself (Diabetes mellitus, Cancer) are not here.

016.57809008: Myocardial disease includes acute myocardial infarction, acute myocarditis and acute cor pulmonale; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled acute processes are not chronic heart disease
016.698247007: Cardiac arrhythmia includes cardiac arrest, benign ectopy and neonatal rate changes; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled benign ectopy and isolated conduction findings are not chronic heart disease

017.17097001: Chronic disease of respiratory system includes upper-airway disease; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled chronic lung disease excludes sinusitis, rhinitis and tonsillitis

040.228366006: Finding relating to drug misuse behavior is wider than illicit drug use

080.293104008: Adverse reaction to component of vaccine product includes any adverse effect; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled this condition is a severe allergy to a vaccine component

086.293115003: an adverse reaction to a pertussis-containing vaccine component is wider than a severe allergic reaction (OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruling on adverse effects)

087.219085007: an adverse reaction to a diphtheria-containing vaccine component is wider than a severe allergic reaction (OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruling on adverse effects)

088.219084006: an adverse reaction to a tetanus-containing vaccine component is wider than a severe allergic reaction (OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruling on adverse effects)

254.128292002: Chronic disease of cardiovascular system includes venous and cerebrovascular disease; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled this condition is cardiac and arterial disease
254.400047006: Peripheral vascular disease includes vessel injuries, venous disease and skin vascular disorders; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 ruled this condition is cardiac and arterial disease

258.414027002: Disorder of hematopoietic structure includes lymph node, tonsil, spleen and bone disorders, many acute

review_rows._comment: Single 'wider' rows sent to the review sheet for a cause other than a broad CDC code, keyed observation|icd10cm.
review_rows.013|D81.30: SNOMED files adenosine deaminase deficiency under SCID; OpenEvidence 2026-10-19 said unspecified ADA deficiency is not SCID

code_grades._comment: Grades for single CDC rows, keyed system|code|observation. Default for a CDC row is 'equivalent'.
CDCPHINVS|VXC20|*: 'Allergy to previous dose of THIS vaccine': names no vaccine, so it cannot say which antigen.
SNOMED|13645005|017: COPD is a chronic lung disease; 214 is the exact observation.
SNOMED|87433001|017: Emphysema is a chronic lung disease; 215 is the exact observation.
SNOMED|31323000|147: SCID is a complete T-lymphocyte defect; 013 is the exact observation.

_comment: Antibody tests are evidence of immunity only when the result is positive. Each row asserts its observation
only with a positive result: Observation.interpretation POS, DET or RR (v3 ObservationInterpretation;
WR 'weakly reactive' is below the reliable limit and does not count), or a valueCodeableConcept of
SNOMED 10828004 Positive, 260373001 Detected or 11214006 Reactive. Codes and displays validated against
tx.fhir.org 2026-09-03 (observation_crosswalk.json). The 2026-02-06 file filed hepatitis B surface
antibody under 024 and hepatitis A IgG under 025; they belong to 019 and 018.

rxnorm._comment: The 2026-02-06 file put acyclovir (281), famciclovir (68099) and valacyclovir (73645) under 033, INFLUENZA antivirals; CDC lists amantadine, rimantadine, zanamivir and oseltamivir there and has no herpes-antiviral observation, so they are dropped. Aspirin stays as a link: 034 is in not_from_a_code.

cpt._comment: Validated with display against tx.fhir.org 2026-09-03. Splenectomy CPT (38100-38120) sat under 002, 'undergoing ELECTIVE splenectomy', which no completed procedure can establish (see not_from_a_code). Grey, 2026-10-18: a completed total splenectomy asserts 160 asplenia; asplenia is wider than the procedure. 38101 (partial) and 38115 (splenorrhaphy with or without partial splenectomy) leave spleen behind and are not mapped. The engine reads only completed Procedures.
160: Splenectomy; total, en bloc for extensive disease, in conjunction with other procedure (List in addition to code for primary procedure)
